mustKnow.en: Cloud computing: delivering computing services (servers, storage, databases, networking, software) over the internet ('the cloud') on a pay-as-you-go basis. Key feature: on-demand self-service.
mustKnow.bn: Cloud computing: internet ('cloud')-এর মাধ্যমে computing services (servers, storage, databases, networking, software) প্রদান করা, pay-as-you-go ভিত্তিতে। মূল বৈশিষ্ট্য: on-demand self-service।

mustKnow.en: Three cloud service models — IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service): raw compute/storage/network (e.g. AWS EC2). PaaS (Platform as a Service): runtime + tools (e.g. Google App Engine). SaaS (Software as a Service): ready-made apps (e.g. Gmail, Salesforce).
mustKnow.bn: তিনটি cloud service model — IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service): raw compute/storage/network (যেমন AWS EC2)। PaaS (Platform as a Service): runtime + tools (যেমন Google App Engine)। SaaS (Software as a Service): ready-made apps (যেমন Gmail, Salesforce)।

mustKnow.en: Cloud deployment models: Public (shared infrastructure, e.g. AWS), Private (dedicated, on-premises or hosted), Hybrid (mix of public + private), Community (shared by organizations with common needs).
mustKnow.bn: Cloud deployment model: Public (shared infrastructure, যেমন AWS), Private (dedicated, on-premises বা hosted), Hybrid (public + private-এর মিশ্রণ), Community (common needs সহ organizations-এর মধ্যে shared)।

mustKnow.en: Cloud advantages: scalability, cost savings (no upfront hardware), global reach, disaster recovery, automatic updates. Disadvantages: internet dependency, security/privacy concerns, vendor lock-in, limited control.
mustKnow.bn: Cloud সুবিধা: scalability, cost savings (কোনো upfront hardware নেই), global reach, disaster recovery, automatic updates। অসুবিধা: internet নির্ভরতা, security/privacy উদ্বেগ, vendor lock-in, সীমিত নিয়ন্ত্রণ।

mustKnow.en: Virtualisation: creating a software-based (virtual) version of a physical resource (server, storage, network). Enables one physical machine to run multiple isolated virtual machines (VMs) simultaneously.
mustKnow.bn: Virtualisation: একটি physical resource (server, storage, network)-এর software-based (virtual) version তৈরি করা। একটি physical machine-কে একসঙ্গে একাধিক isolated virtual machine (VM) চালাতে সক্ষম করে।

mustKnow.en: Hypervisor (Virtual Machine Monitor / VMM): software that creates and manages VMs. Type 1 (Bare-metal): runs directly on hardware (e.g. VMware ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, KVM). Type 2 (Hosted): runs on a host OS (e.g. VMware Workstation, VirtualBox).
mustKnow.bn: Hypervisor (Virtual Machine Monitor / VMM): VM তৈরি এবং পরিচালনা করে। Type 1 (Bare-metal): সরাসরি hardware-এ চলে (যেমন VMware ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, KVM)। Type 2 (Hosted): host OS-এ চলে (যেমন VMware Workstation, VirtualBox)।

mustKnow.en: Virtual Machine (VM): a software emulation of a complete computer. Each VM has its own OS, CPU, memory, storage. VMs are isolated from each other and from the host.
mustKnow.bn: Virtual Machine (VM): একটি complete computer-এর software emulation। প্রতিটি VM-এর নিজস্ব OS, CPU, memory, storage আছে। VM-গুলো পরস্পর এবং host থেকে isolated।

mustKnow.en: VM vs Container: VMs include a full OS (heavier, ~GBs); containers share the host OS kernel (lighter, ~MBs, start in seconds). Docker is the most popular container platform. Kubernetes orchestrates containers at scale.
mustKnow.bn: VM vs Container: VM-এ full OS থাকে (ভারী, ~GBs); container host OS kernel share করে (হালকা, ~MBs, সেকেন্ডে শুরু)। Docker সবচেয়ে জনপ্রিয় container platform। Kubernetes বড় মাপে container orchestrate করে।

mustKnow.en: Horizontal scaling (scale-out): adding more servers/instances to distribute load. Vertical scaling (scale-up): increasing CPU/RAM of an existing server. Auto-scaling: automatically adds/removes instances based on demand.
mustKnow.bn: Horizontal scaling (scale-out): load বিতরণ করতে আরো server/instance যোগ করা। Vertical scaling (scale-up): একটি বিদ্যমান server-এর CPU/RAM বাড়ানো। Auto-scaling: demand অনুযায়ী স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে instance যোগ বা সরানো।

mustKnow.en: Data centre: a facility housing servers, storage, network equipment, and supporting infrastructure (power, cooling, security). Key components: servers, storage arrays, networking gear (switches, routers), UPS, cooling systems, fire suppression.
mustKnow.bn: Data centre: server, storage, network equipment এবং supporting infrastructure (power, cooling, security) রাখার সুবিধা। মূল উপাদান: servers, storage arrays, networking gear (switches, routers), UPS, cooling systems, fire suppression।

mustKnow.en: Data centre Tier classification: Tier 1 (99.671% uptime, basic), Tier 2 (99.741%, redundant components), Tier 3 (99.982%, concurrently maintainable), Tier 4 (99.995%, fault tolerant). Bangladesh NCC (National Data Centre) is Tier 3.
mustKnow.bn: Data centre Tier classification: Tier 1 (99.671% uptime, basic), Tier 2 (99.741%, redundant components), Tier 3 (99.982%, concurrently maintainable), Tier 4 (99.995%, fault tolerant)। বাংলাদেশ NCC (National Data Centre) Tier 3।

mustKnow.en: Data centre energy efficiency metric: PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness) = Total facility power / IT equipment power. PUE of 1.0 is perfect. Industry average ~1.5. Green data centres aim for PUE < 1.2.
mustKnow.bn: Data centre energy efficiency metric: PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness) = Total facility power / IT equipment power। PUE 1.0 perfect। Industry average ~1.5। Green data centre PUE < 1.2 লক্ষ্য রাখে।

mustKnow.en: Data centre cooling methods: Computer Room Air Conditioners (CRACs), hot aisle/cold aisle containment, liquid cooling, free cooling (outside air). Energy efficiency challenge: cooling can use 40% of total power.
mustKnow.bn: Data centre cooling method: Computer Room Air Conditioners (CRACs), hot aisle/cold aisle containment, liquid cooling, free cooling (outside air)। Energy efficiency চ্যালেঞ্জ: cooling মোট power-এর 40% ব্যবহার করতে পারে।

mustKnow.en: Server types: Tower server (standalone, like a desktop PC), Rack server (fits in standard 19'' rack, measured in 'U' units), Blade server (thin modules in a shared chassis — high density, shared power/cooling).
mustKnow.bn: Server type: Tower server (standalone, desktop PC-এর মতো), Rack server (standard 19'' rack-এ ফিট, 'U' unit-এ পরিমাপ), Blade server (shared chassis-এ পাতলা modules — উচ্চ density, shared power/cooling)।

mustKnow.en: Big Data 5 Vs: Volume (massive data), Velocity (high speed), Variety (structured/unstructured), Veracity (accuracy/trustworthiness), Value (business insight). Hadoop ecosystem: HDFS (storage), MapReduce (processing), YARN (resource management), Hive, Spark.
mustKnow.bn: Big Data 5 V: Volume (বিশাল data), Velocity (উচ্চ গতি), Variety (structured/unstructured), Veracity (accuracy/trustworthiness), Value (business insight)। Hadoop ecosystem: HDFS (storage), MapReduce (processing), YARN (resource management), Hive, Spark।

mustKnow.en: Disaster Recovery (DR): plan to restore IT systems after a disaster. RTO (Recovery Time Objective): max acceptable downtime. RPO (Recovery Point Objective): max acceptable data loss (time). Business Continuity Plan (BCP) is broader than DR.
mustKnow.bn: Disaster Recovery (DR): disaster-এর পরে IT systems পুনরুদ্ধারের পরিকল্পনা। RTO (Recovery Time Objective): সর্বোচ্চ গ্রহণযোগ্য downtime। RPO (Recovery Point Objective): সর্বোচ্চ গ্রহণযোগ্য data loss (সময়)। Business Continuity Plan (BCP) DR-এর চেয়ে বিস্তৃত।

mustKnow.en: Edge computing: processing data near its source (at the 'edge' of the network) rather than sending everything to a central cloud. Reduces latency, bandwidth usage. Use: IoT devices, real-time analytics, autonomous vehicles.
mustKnow.bn: Edge computing: সব কিছু central cloud-এ না পাঠিয়ে data-র উৎসের কাছে (network-এর 'edge'-এ) processing করা। Latency ও bandwidth ব্যবহার কমায়। ব্যবহার: IoT devices, real-time analytics, autonomous vehicles।

mustKnow.en: Server maintenance types: Preventive (scheduled, proactive — cleaning, patch updates, health checks) vs Corrective (reactive, after failure — troubleshooting and repair). Preventive maintenance extends server life.
mustKnow.bn: Server maintenance type: Preventive (scheduled, proactive — cleaning, patch updates, health checks) vs Corrective (reactive, failure-এর পরে — troubleshooting ও repair)। Preventive maintenance server-এর আয়ু বাড়ায়।

mustKnow.en: System reliability for components in series: R_total = R1 × R2 × R3 ... (each component must work). Example: 3 components each with R=0.95 in series → R_total = 0.95³ = 0.857.
mustKnow.bn: Series-এ components-এর জন্য system reliability: R_total = R1 × R2 × R3 ... (প্রতিটি component কাজ করতে হবে)। উদাহরণ: R=0.95 সহ 3টি components series-এ → R_total = 0.95³ = 0.857।

mustKnow.en: Kubernetes (K8s) architecture: Master node (API Server, Scheduler, Controller Manager, etcd) controls Worker nodes (Kubelet, Container Runtime, Kube-proxy). Pods are the smallest deployable unit.
mustKnow.bn: Kubernetes (K8s) architecture: Master node (API Server, Scheduler, Controller Manager, etcd) Worker node (Kubelet, Container Runtime, Kube-proxy) নিয়ন্ত্রণ করে। Pod হলো সবচেয়ে ছোট deployable unit।

question.en: A critical system has 3 components (Power Supply, Motherboard, Storage) in series, each with reliability 0.95. What is the total system reliability?
question.bn: একটি critical system-এ series-এ 3টি components (Power Supply, Motherboard, Storage) আছে, প্রতিটির reliability 0.95। মোট system reliability কত?

working.en: R_total = 0.95 × 0.95 × 0.95 = 0.95³ = 0.857. If any one component fails, the whole system fails (series).
working.bn: R_total = 0.95 × 0.95 × 0.95 = 0.95³ = 0.857। একটি component নষ্ট হলে পুরো system নষ্ট হয় (series)।

formulas.formula: PUE = Total Facility Power / IT Equipment Power

question.en: A data centre uses 2 MW total power, of which 1.4 MW powers IT equipment. What is its PUE?
question.bn: একটি data centre মোট 2 MW power ব্যবহার করে, যার মধ্যে 1.4 MW IT equipment-এ যায়। এর PUE কত?

working.en: PUE = 2.0 / 1.4 = 1.43. A PUE of 1.43 means that for every 1W powering IT, 0.43W goes to overhead (cooling, lighting, etc.). Target: PUE < 1.2 for green data centres.
working.bn: PUE = 2.0 / 1.4 = 1.43। PUE 1.43 মানে IT-তে প্রতি 1W-এর জন্য, overhead (cooling, lighting, ইত্যাদি)-এ 0.43W যায়। লক্ষ্য: green data centre-এর জন্য PUE < 1.2।

traps.en: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS confusion: IaaS = you manage OS and above (virtual machines); PaaS = you manage only application code; SaaS = you use a finished product. As you go from IaaS→SaaS, you control less but vendor manages more.
traps.bn: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS বিভ্রান্তি: IaaS = আপনি OS ও উপরে পরিচালনা করেন (virtual machines); PaaS = শুধু application code পরিচালনা করেন; SaaS = একটি সম্পূর্ণ product ব্যবহার করেন। IaaS→SaaS-এ যাওয়ার সাথে সাথে আপনার নিয়ন্ত্রণ কমে কিন্তু vendor বেশি পরিচালনা করে।

traps.en: Type 1 vs Type 2 Hypervisor: Type 1 (bare-metal) runs directly on hardware — no host OS (VMware ESXi, Hyper-V, KVM). Type 2 (hosted) needs a host OS first (VirtualBox, VMware Workstation). Type 1 is used in production data centres; Type 2 is for development/testing on personal computers.
traps.bn: Type 1 vs Type 2 Hypervisor: Type 1 (bare-metal) সরাসরি hardware-এ চলে — কোনো host OS নেই (VMware ESXi, Hyper-V, KVM)। Type 2 (hosted)-এর প্রথমে host OS দরকার (VirtualBox, VMware Workstation)। Type 1 production data centre-এ; Type 2 personal computer-এ development/testing-এর জন্য।

traps.en: VM vs Container: A container is NOT a VM. VMs virtualise hardware; containers virtualise the OS. Containers share the host kernel — they are isolated at the process level, not hardware level. Docker ≠ virtual machine.
traps.bn: VM vs Container: Container VM নয়। VM hardware virtualise করে; container OS virtualise করে। Container host kernel share করে — এগুলো hardware level-এ নয়, process level-এ isolated। Docker ≠ virtual machine।

traps.en: Horizontal vs Vertical scaling: horizontal = MORE servers (adds redundancy too); vertical = BIGGER server (has an upper limit, and creates a single point of failure). Cloud-native systems prefer horizontal scaling.
traps.bn: Horizontal vs Vertical scaling: horizontal = বেশি server (redundancy-ও যোগ করে); vertical = বড় server (একটি upper limit আছে এবং single point of failure তৈরি করে)। Cloud-native systems horizontal scaling পছন্দ করে।

traps.en: Cloud is NOT always cheaper: pay-as-you-go scales costs with usage. For predictable, steady workloads, on-premises can be cheaper. Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis is required before migration.
traps.bn: Cloud সবসময় সস্তা নয়: pay-as-you-go ব্যবহারের সাথে cost বাড়ে। predictable, steady workload-এর জন্য, on-premises সস্তা হতে পারে। migration-এর আগে Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) বিশ্লেষণ প্রয়োজন।

traps.en: PUE: lower is better. PUE of 1.0 is theoretically perfect (impossible). PUE of 2.0 means 50% of power is wasted on overhead. Google's data centres achieve PUE ~1.1.
traps.bn: PUE: কম মানে ভালো। PUE 1.0 theoretically perfect (অসম্ভব)। PUE 2.0 মানে 50% power overhead-এ নষ্ট হয়। Google-এর data centre PUE ~1.1 অর্জন করে।

question.en: What is cloud computing? Explain its service models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) with examples. What are the advantages and disadvantages of cloud computing?
question.bn: Cloud computing কী? উদাহরণসহ এর service model (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) ব্যাখ্যা করুন। Cloud computing-এর সুবিধা ও অসুবিধা কী?

en: Define cloud computing: on-demand delivery of IT resources over internet on pay-as-you-go basis. NIST definition: on-demand self-service, broad network access, resource pooling, rapid elasticity, measured service.
IaaS: provides raw infrastructure (VMs, storage, networking). User manages OS and above. Examples: AWS EC2, Azure VMs, Google Compute Engine.
PaaS: provides platform for building apps. User manages only the application. Examples: Google App Engine, Azure App Service, Heroku.
SaaS: provides ready-made software over internet. User just uses the app. Examples: Gmail, Microsoft 365, Salesforce, Google Docs.
Deployment models: Public (AWS/Azure/GCP), Private (own infrastructure), Hybrid (mix), Community.
Advantages: on-demand scalability, cost savings (no upfront hardware), global reach, automatic updates, disaster recovery, collaboration.
Disadvantages: internet dependency, data security/privacy risks, vendor lock-in, limited customisation, ongoing subscription costs.
bn: Cloud computing সংজ্ঞা: pay-as-you-go ভিত্তিতে internet-এ on-demand IT resources প্রদান। NIST সংজ্ঞা: on-demand self-service, broad network access, resource pooling, rapid elasticity, measured service।
IaaS: raw infrastructure (VMs, storage, networking) প্রদান করে। User OS ও উপরে পরিচালনা করে। উদাহরণ: AWS EC2, Azure VMs, Google Compute Engine।
PaaS: app তৈরির জন্য platform প্রদান করে। User শুধু application পরিচালনা করে। উদাহরণ: Google App Engine, Azure App Service, Heroku।
SaaS: internet-এ ready-made software প্রদান করে। User শুধু app ব্যবহার করে। উদাহরণ: Gmail, Microsoft 365, Salesforce, Google Docs।
Deployment model: Public (AWS/Azure/GCP), Private (নিজস্ব infrastructure), Hybrid (মিশ্রণ), Community।
সুবিধা: on-demand scalability, cost savings (কোনো upfront hardware নেই), global reach, automatic updates, disaster recovery, collaboration।
অসুবিধা: internet নির্ভরতা, data security/privacy ঝুঁকি, vendor lock-in, সীমিত customisation, চলমান subscription cost।

5.en: Cloud computing = on-demand IT services via internet. IaaS = VMs/storage (AWS EC2). PaaS = development platform (Heroku). SaaS = ready-made apps (Gmail). Advantages: scalable, cost-effective. Disadvantages: internet-dependent, security risks.
5.bn: Cloud computing = internet-এ on-demand IT services। IaaS = VMs/storage (AWS EC2)। PaaS = development platform (Heroku)। SaaS = ready-made apps (Gmail)। সুবিধা: scalable, cost-effective। অসুবিধা: internet-নির্ভর, security ঝুঁকি।

10.bn: NIST-এর 5টি বৈশিষ্ট্যসহ পূর্ণ সংজ্ঞা, প্রতিটিতে 2টি উদাহরণসহ 3টি service model, 4টি deployment model, 5টি সুবিধা (scalability, OPEX vs CAPEX, global reach, DR, auto-updates), 4টি অসুবিধা (internet নির্ভরতা, vendor lock-in, security, TCO)।

question.en: Define virtualisation and hypervisor. Explain the types of hypervisors with examples. What is the difference between a Virtual Machine (VM) and a container?
question.bn: Virtualisation এবং hypervisor সংজ্ঞায়িত করুন। উদাহরণসহ hypervisor-এর types ব্যাখ্যা করুন। Virtual Machine (VM) এবং container-এর মধ্যে পার্থক্য কী?

en: Virtualisation: creating a software-based version of a physical resource. Allows one server to run multiple VMs, maximizing hardware utilisation.
Hypervisor (VMM): software layer that creates and manages VMs by abstracting hardware from software.
Type 1 (Bare-metal): runs directly on hardware (no host OS). Examples: VMware ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, KVM. Used in production data centres. Better performance and security.
Type 2 (Hosted): runs on top of a host OS. Examples: VMware Workstation, Oracle VirtualBox. Used for development, testing on personal computers.
VM: includes full guest OS, hypervisor-based, ~GBs, slower start (minutes), strong isolation. Examples: VMware, VirtualBox.
Container: shares host OS kernel, uses Docker Engine, ~MBs, instant start (seconds), process-level isolation. Examples: Docker, Kubernetes pods.
Table comparing VM vs Container: OS, size, startup time, isolation, use case.
Benefits of VMs: server consolidation, isolation, easy backup/snapshot, legacy app support, test environments.
bn: Virtualisation: একটি physical resource-এর software-based version তৈরি করা। একটি server-কে একাধিক VM চালাতে সক্ষম করে, hardware utilisation সর্বাধিক করে।
Hypervisor (VMM): hardware থেকে software abstract করে VM তৈরি ও পরিচালনা করে।
Type 1 (Bare-metal): সরাসরি hardware-এ চলে (কোনো host OS নেই)। উদাহরণ: VMware ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, KVM। Production data centre-এ ব্যবহৃত। ভালো performance ও security।
Type 2 (Hosted): host OS-এর উপরে চলে। উদাহরণ: VMware Workstation, Oracle VirtualBox। Personal computer-এ development, testing-এর জন্য ব্যবহৃত।
VM: সম্পূর্ণ guest OS অন্তর্ভুক্ত, hypervisor-based, ~GBs, ধীর শুরু (minutes), শক্তিশালী isolation। উদাহরণ: VMware, VirtualBox।
Container: host OS kernel share করে, Docker Engine ব্যবহার করে, ~MBs, তাৎক্ষণিক শুরু (seconds), process-level isolation। উদাহরণ: Docker, Kubernetes pods।
VM vs Container তুলনামূলক সারণি: OS, size, startup time, isolation, use case।
VM-এর সুবিধা: server consolidation, isolation, সহজ backup/snapshot, legacy app support, test environment।

5.en: Virtualisation = running multiple VMs on one physical machine. Hypervisor = software managing VMs. Type 1 (bare-metal, e.g. ESXi) vs Type 2 (hosted, e.g. VirtualBox). VM = full OS (~GBs, minutes), Container = shared OS (~MBs, seconds).
5.bn: Virtualisation = একটি physical machine-এ একাধিক VM চালানো। Hypervisor = VM পরিচালনাকারী software। Type 1 (bare-metal, যেমন ESXi) vs Type 2 (hosted, যেমন VirtualBox)। VM = full OS (~GBs, minutes), Container = shared OS (~MBs, seconds)।

10.en: Define virtualisation and hypervisor. Explain Type 1 and Type 2 hypervisors with 2 examples each, and when to use each. Then compare VMs and containers across 5 dimensions: OS, size, startup time, isolation, and primary use case.
10.bn: Virtualisation ও hypervisor সংজ্ঞায়িত করুন। প্রতিটিতে 2টি উদাহরণ এবং কখন ব্যবহার করবেন সহ Type 1 ও Type 2 hypervisor ব্যাখ্যা করুন। তারপর 5টি মাত্রায় VM ও container তুলনা করুন: OS, size, startup time, isolation, এবং primary use case।

question.en: What are the key challenges in optimising the energy efficiency of data centres? How can a data centre reduce its power consumption and carbon footprint?
question.bn: Data centre-এর energy efficiency অপ্টিমাইজ করার মূল চ্যালেঞ্জগুলো কী? একটি data centre কীভাবে এর power consumption এবং carbon footprint কমাতে পারে?

en: Define PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness) = Total facility power / IT equipment power. Ideal = 1.0; average ~1.5.

Challenges: (1) Cooling (40% of power) — hot aisle/cold aisle, CRAC units. (2) Server utilisation — idle servers still consume 60-70% power. (3) Legacy equipment inefficiency. (4) High-density racks generating concentrated heat. (5) 24/7 uptime requirement.

Energy efficiency strategies: (1) Virtualisation/consolidation — run multiple VMs on fewer physical servers. (2) Hot/cold aisle containment. (3) Free cooling (outside air in winter). (4) Liquid cooling for high-density racks. (5) Renewable energy (solar/wind). (6) Efficient UPS systems. (7) LED lighting, automated power management. (8) Right-sizing servers.
Green certifications: LEED, ENERGY STAR. Google, Meta data centres use renewable energy and innovative cooling.
Bangladesh NCC (National Data Centre): Tier 3, Kaliakair, Gazipur — uses N+1 redundancy, modern cooling.
bn: PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness) সংজ্ঞা = Total facility power / IT equipment power। Ideal = 1.0; গড় ~1.5।

চ্যালেঞ্জ: (1) Cooling (power-এর 40%) — hot aisle/cold aisle, CRAC units। (2) Server utilisation — idle server এখনও 60-70% power ব্যবহার করে। (3) Legacy equipment অদক্ষতা। (4) উচ্চ-ঘনত্বের rack ঘনীভূত তাপ উৎপন্ন করে। (5) 24/7 uptime প্রয়োজনীয়তা।

Energy efficiency কৌশল: (1) Virtualisation/consolidation — কম physical server-এ একাধিক VM চালানো। (2) Hot/cold aisle containment। (3) Free cooling (শীতকালে বাইরের বায়ু)। (4) High-density rack-এর জন্য liquid cooling। (5) Renewable energy (solar/wind)। (6) দক্ষ UPS systems। (7) LED lighting, automated power management। (8) Right-sizing servers।
Green certification: LEED, ENERGY STAR। Google, Meta data centre renewable energy ও innovative cooling ব্যবহার করে।
বাংলাদেশ NCC (National Data Centre): Tier 3, কালিয়াকৈর, গাজীপুর — N+1 redundancy, আধুনিক cooling ব্যবহার করে।

5.en: PUE = total power / IT power (lower = better). Challenges: cooling (40% of power), server underutilisation, legacy equipment. Solutions: virtualisation, hot/cold aisle, free cooling, renewable energy.
5.bn: PUE = total power / IT power (কম = ভালো)। চ্যালেঞ্জ: cooling (power-এর 40%), server underutilisation, legacy equipment। সমাধান: virtualisation, hot/cold aisle, free cooling, renewable energy।

10.en: Define PUE with formula and example. List 5 specific challenges. Give 7 concrete energy efficiency strategies. Include Bangladesh NCC context and green certifications (LEED, ENERGY STAR).
10.bn: Formula ও উদাহরণসহ PUE সংজ্ঞায়িত করুন। 5টি নির্দিষ্ট চ্যালেঞ্জ তালিকা করুন। 7টি concrete energy efficiency কৌশল দিন। বাংলাদেশ NCC প্রসঙ্গ ও green certification (LEED, ENERGY STAR) অন্তর্ভুক্ত করুন।

q.en: What is the difference between IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS?
q.bn: IaaS, PaaS এবং SaaS-এর মধ্যে পার্থক্য কী?

a.en: IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service): provider gives raw infrastructure (VMs, storage, network); customer manages OS and above. Example: AWS EC2. PaaS (Platform as a Service): provider gives OS + runtime + tools; customer manages only application code. Example: Google App Engine. SaaS (Software as a Service): provider gives complete application; customer just uses it. Example: Gmail, Salesforce.
a.bn: IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service): provider raw infrastructure (VMs, storage, network) দেয়; customer OS ও উপরে পরিচালনা করে। উদাহরণ: AWS EC2। PaaS (Platform as a Service): provider OS + runtime + tools দেয়; customer শুধু application code পরিচালনা করে। উদাহরণ: Google App Engine। SaaS (Software as a Service): provider complete application দেয়; customer শুধু ব্যবহার করে। উদাহরণ: Gmail, Salesforce।

q.en: What is a hypervisor and what are the two types?
q.bn: Hypervisor কী এবং দুটি type কী?

a.en: A hypervisor (Virtual Machine Monitor) is software that creates and runs virtual machines by abstracting hardware resources. Type 1 (bare-metal): runs directly on hardware without a host OS — used in production data centres (VMware ESXi, Hyper-V, KVM). Type 2 (hosted): runs on top of an existing OS — used for personal development and testing (VirtualBox, VMware Workstation). Type 1 is faster and more secure because it has fewer software layers.
a.bn: Hypervisor (Virtual Machine Monitor) হলো software যা hardware resources abstract করে virtual machine তৈরি ও চালায়। Type 1 (bare-metal): host OS ছাড়া সরাসরি hardware-এ চলে — production data centre-এ ব্যবহৃত (VMware ESXi, Hyper-V, KVM)। Type 2 (hosted): বিদ্যমান OS-এর উপরে চলে — personal development ও testing-এর জন্য (VirtualBox, VMware Workstation)। Type 1 দ্রুত ও বেশি secure কারণ এতে কম software layer আছে।

q.en: What is the difference between horizontal and vertical scaling?
q.bn: Horizontal ও vertical scaling-এর মধ্যে পার্থক্য কী?

a.en: Vertical scaling (scale-up): increase the power of an existing server — more CPU, RAM, storage. Has an upper limit and creates a single point of failure. Horizontal scaling (scale-out): add more servers to distribute load. Adds redundancy and is preferred for cloud-native systems. Auto-scaling extends horizontal scaling by automatically adding/removing instances based on real-time demand.
a.bn: Vertical scaling (scale-up): একটি বিদ্যমান server-এর power বাড়ানো — বেশি CPU, RAM, storage। একটি upper limit আছে এবং single point of failure তৈরি করে। Horizontal scaling (scale-out): load বিতরণ করতে আরো server যোগ করা। Redundancy যোগ করে এবং cloud-native systems-এর জন্য পছন্দের। Auto-scaling real-time demand-এর উপর ভিত্তি করে স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে instance যোগ/সরিয়ে horizontal scaling প্রসারিত করে।

q.en: What is edge computing and why is it needed?
q.bn: Edge computing কী এবং কেন এটি প্রয়োজন?

a.en: Edge computing processes data near its source (at the 'edge' of the network — in local devices or nearby servers) instead of sending everything to a central cloud data centre. It is needed when: (1) low latency is critical (autonomous vehicles, industrial IoT, real-time gaming); (2) bandwidth is limited (large volumes of sensor data); (3) data privacy requires local processing. It complements cloud — edge handles real-time local processing while cloud handles large-scale analysis and storage.
a.bn: Edge computing সব কিছু central cloud data centre-এ না পাঠিয়ে data-র উৎসের কাছে (network-এর 'edge'-এ — local devices বা nearby servers-এ) process করে। এটি প্রয়োজন যখন: (1) low latency critical (autonomous vehicles, industrial IoT, real-time gaming); (2) bandwidth সীমিত (sensor data-র বড় পরিমাণ); (3) data privacy local processing প্রয়োজন। এটি cloud-এর পরিপূরক — edge real-time local processing করে যখন cloud বড় মাপে বিশ্লেষণ ও storage করে।

q.en: What are the key components of a data centre?

a.en: A data centre contains: (1) Servers (compute): rack, blade, or tower servers that process data. (2) Storage systems: SANs, NAS, or cloud storage. (3) Networking: switches, routers, firewalls, load balancers. (4) Power infrastructure: UPS (uninterruptible power supply), PDUs, diesel generators for backup. (5) Cooling: CRAC units, hot/cold aisle containment, chilled water systems. (6) Physical security: CCTV, access control, biometric locks. (7) Fire suppression: clean agent (gas-based, not water) systems.
a.bn: Data centre-এ থাকে: (1) Servers (compute): data process করার জন্য rack, blade, বা tower server। (2) Storage systems: SANs, NAS, বা cloud storage। (3) Networking: switches, routers, firewalls, load balancers। (4) Power infrastructure: UPS (uninterruptible power supply), PDUs, backup-এর জন্য diesel generators। (5) Cooling: CRAC units, hot/cold aisle containment, chilled water systems। (6) Physical security: CCTV, access control, biometric locks। (7) Fire suppression: clean agent (gas-based, water নয়) systems।

overview.en: Cloud computing, virtualisation, and data centres are heavily tested in bank/PSU exams. Banks ask application-level questions (should we migrate? which RAID? what cooling?); NTRCA asks definitions; BUET-pattern asks architecture and design. Master the service models, hypervisor types, VM vs container, scaling strategies, and data centre management.
overview.bn: Cloud computing, virtualisation এবং data centre bank/PSU পরীক্ষায় ব্যাপকভাবে পরীক্ষিত হয়। ব্যাংক application-level প্রশ্ন করে (migrate করব? কোন RAID? কোন cooling?); NTRCA সংজ্ঞা জিজ্ঞেস করে; BUET-pattern architecture ও design জিজ্ঞেস করে। Service model, hypervisor type, VM vs container, scaling strategies এবং data centre management আয়ত্ত করুন।

points.en: Cloud service model responsibility: IaaS (customer manages: OS, middleware, runtime, apps, data) / PaaS (customer manages: apps, data only) / SaaS (customer manages: nothing — just uses it).
points.bn: Cloud service model responsibility: IaaS (customer পরিচালনা করে: OS, middleware, runtime, apps, data) / PaaS (customer পরিচালনা করে: শুধু apps, data) / SaaS (customer কিছু পরিচালনা করে না — শুধু ব্যবহার করে)।

points.en: Server rack units: 1U = 1.75 inches. A standard rack is 42U. Blade servers fit multiple server boards (blades) into one chassis with shared power, cooling, and networking.
points.bn: Server rack unit: 1U = 1.75 inches। একটি standard rack 42U। Blade server একটি chassis-এ shared power, cooling এবং networking সহ একাধিক server board (blade) ফিট করে।

points.en: Disaster Recovery tiers: Hot site (fully operational duplicate — instant recovery), Warm site (partially equipped — hours), Cold site (empty facility — days). RTO and RPO determine which tier is needed.
points.bn: Disaster Recovery tier: Hot site (সম্পূর্ণ operational duplicate — তাৎক্ষণিক recovery), Warm site (আংশিকভাবে সজ্জিত — ঘণ্টা), Cold site (খালি সুবিধা — দিন)। RTO ও RPO কোন tier দরকার তা নির্ধারণ করে।

points.en: Kubernetes components: Master (API Server — all communication; Scheduler — assigns pods to nodes; Controller Manager — maintains desired state; etcd — distributed key-value store for cluster state). Worker (Kubelet — manages pods on node; Kube-proxy — network rules; Container Runtime — runs containers).
points.bn: Kubernetes উপাদান: Master (API Server — সব communication; Scheduler — pods node-এ assign করে; Controller Manager — desired state বজায় রাখে; etcd — cluster state-এর জন্য distributed key-value store)। Worker (Kubelet — node-এ pods পরিচালনা করে; Kube-proxy — network rules; Container Runtime — containers চালায়)।

points.en: Hadoop ecosystem roles: HDFS (Hadoop Distributed File System) stores data across nodes; MapReduce processes data in parallel; YARN (Yet Another Resource Negotiator) manages cluster resources; Hive = SQL-like querying; Spark = faster in-memory processing.
points.bn: Hadoop ecosystem roles: HDFS (Hadoop Distributed File System) node-এ data সংরক্ষণ করে; MapReduce parallel-এ data process করে; YARN (Yet Another Resource Negotiator) cluster resources পরিচালনা করে; Hive = SQL-like querying; Spark = দ্রুত in-memory processing।

question.en: A bank's server traffic rises from 10,000 to 50,000 hits. They do not migrate to cloud. What are the business and technical consequences?
question.bn: একটি ব্যাংকের server traffic 10,000 থেকে 50,000 hit-এ বাড়ে। তারা cloud-এ migrate করে না। ব্যবসায়িক ও technical পরিণতি কী?

working.en: Technical: server overload → slow response times → timeouts and errors → potential downtime. Business: loss of customer trust, regulatory non-compliance (uptime SLAs), lost transactions, reputational damage. Solution: vertical scaling (short-term) + cloud migration or horizontal scaling + load balancing (long-term).
working.bn: Technical: server overload → ধীর response time → timeout ও error → সম্ভাব্য downtime। ব্যবসায়িক: customer-এর আস্থা হারানো, regulatory non-compliance (uptime SLA), হারানো transaction, সুনামের ক্ষতি। সমাধান: vertical scaling (স্বল্পমেয়াদী) + cloud migration বা horizontal scaling + load balancing (দীর্ঘমেয়াদী)।

answer.en: Technical consequences: performance degradation, server crashes, downtime. Business consequences: customer dissatisfaction, SLA breaches, revenue loss. Recommended solution: cloud migration with auto-scaling or horizontal scaling with load balancer.
answer.bn: Technical পরিণতি: performance অবনতি, server crash, downtime। ব্যবসায়িক পরিণতি: customer অসন্তুষ্টি, SLA লঙ্ঘন, revenue হারানো। প্রস্তাবিত সমাধান: auto-scaling সহ cloud migration বা load balancer সহ horizontal scaling।

answer.en: Cloud computing is the delivery of computing services (servers, storage, networking, software, analytics) over the internet ('the cloud') on a pay-as-you-go basis. Service models: IaaS (raw infrastructure, e.g. AWS EC2), PaaS (development platform, e.g. Google App Engine), SaaS (ready-made software, e.g. Gmail). Advantages: scalability, cost savings, global reach, disaster recovery. Disadvantages: internet dependency, security risks, vendor lock-in.
answer.bn: Cloud computing হলো pay-as-you-go ভিত্তিতে internet ('cloud')-এর মাধ্যমে computing services (servers, storage, networking, software, analytics) প্রদান। Service model: IaaS (raw infrastructure, যেমন AWS EC2), PaaS (development platform, যেমন Google App Engine), SaaS (ready-made software, যেমন Gmail)। সুবিধা: scalability, cost savings, global reach, disaster recovery। অসুবিধা: internet নির্ভরতা, security ঝুঁকি, vendor lock-in।

answer.en: Key challenges in data centre energy efficiency: (1) Cooling overhead (40% of power) — CRAC units, maintaining hot/cold aisles. (2) Server underutilisation — idle servers still consume 60-70% peak power. (3) Legacy hardware inefficiency. (4) High-density heat concentration. Solutions: virtualisation/consolidation, hot/cold aisle containment, free cooling, liquid cooling, renewable energy, efficient UPS, right-sizing. Metric: PUE = Total power / IT power (lower = better).
answer.bn: Data centre energy efficiency-এর মূল চ্যালেঞ্জ: (1) Cooling overhead (power-এর 40%) — CRAC units, hot/cold aisle বজায় রাখা। (2) Server underutilisation — idle server এখনও 60-70% peak power ব্যবহার করে। (3) Legacy hardware অদক্ষতা। (4) High-density heat concentration। সমাধান: virtualisation/consolidation, hot/cold aisle containment, free cooling, liquid cooling, renewable energy, দক্ষ UPS, right-sizing। Metric: PUE = Total power / IT power (কম = ভালো)।

answer.en: Virtual Machine (VM): a software emulation of a complete physical computer. A hypervisor (VMM) creates multiple VMs on one physical host, each with its own OS, CPU, memory, and storage — fully isolated. How it works: the hypervisor abstracts physical hardware and presents each VM with virtual hardware. The guest OS runs inside the VM believing it has dedicated hardware. Benefits: server consolidation (run 10+ VMs on one server), isolation (VM failure doesn't affect host), easy backup (snapshots), test environments, legacy app support.
answer.bn: Virtual Machine (VM): একটি complete physical computer-এর software emulation। একটি hypervisor (VMM) একটি physical host-এ একাধিক VM তৈরি করে, প্রতিটির নিজস্ব OS, CPU, memory এবং storage — সম্পূর্ণ isolated। কীভাবে কাজ করে: hypervisor physical hardware abstract করে এবং প্রতিটি VM-কে virtual hardware উপস্থাপন করে। Guest OS VM-এর ভেতরে চলে মনে করে এটি dedicated hardware পেয়েছে। সুবিধা: server consolidation (একটি server-এ 10+ VM), isolation (VM failure host-কে প্রভাবিত করে না), সহজ backup (snapshots), test environment, legacy app support।
